verdict.rationale: SOSPortal, the online filing portal open 24/7, publishes 'enhanced security through multi-factor authentication.' That points to a credential-plus-MFA sign-in that can be completed remotely. But the docs never name the MFA factor types or confirm the absence of biometric liveness checks, in-person visits, or mailed PINs. Missing for 10: the specific MFA methods (e.g., TOTP/SMS/email), explicit confirmation that no biometric, in-person, or mailed-PIN step exists for sign-in or account setup, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of the sign-in flow.
